card.name: Modal verbs in old formal prose
card.fires_on: Negating or hedging words right after a modal verb (cannot, could not, would hardly, can ever) in archaic or 18th-19th century essays and political writing, where a rhetorical conclusion follows.

modes.description: The word cannot or the word not right after could, in a formal argument about what is undeniable or unavoidable.
